meta.title: 不会摇镜头？新手稳定器必学模式
meta.title_en: Can't Tilt the Camera? A Must-Learn Gimbal Mode

scenes.context: 双轴跟随在平移跟随的基础上加上下运动：稳定器不仅能随身体左右平移，还能配合上下方向移动。
sentences: 双轴跟随怎么拍？记住对角线原则。
How do you shoot two-axis follow? Remember the diagonal rule.
two-axis follow（双轴跟随）
双轴跟随模式在平移跟随的基础上，加了上下的运动模式。
Two-axis follow adds up-and-down motion on top of pan-follow.
pan-follow（平移跟随）
稳定器不仅可以随着身体左右平移，还可以配合上下方向进行移动。
The gimbal not only pans left and right with your body, but also moves vertically.
vertical movement（上下移动）
scenes.speak: How do you shoot two-axis follow? Remember the diagonal rule. Two-axis follow adds up-and-down motion on top of pan-follow. The gimbal not only pans left and right with your body, but also moves vertically.

scenes.context: 一般使用双轴跟随做由上到下或由下到上的摇镜头，最后带到天空或建筑作为结尾。
sentences: 一般使用双轴跟随模式，都是由上到下或者由下到上的摇镜头方式。
Two-axis follow is usually used for top-to-bottom or bottom-to-top tilt shots.
tilt shot（摇镜头）
最后带到天空或者建筑作为结尾。
Finally, end on the sky or a building.
end on the sky（以天空收尾）
大家在运镜时，提前想好画面的开头和结尾。
Plan the opening and ending of your shot before you start moving.
plan the shot（提前规划镜头）
paraphrase: end on the sky（以天空收尾
end on the sky（以天空收尾
scenes.speak: Two-axis follow is usually used for top-to-bottom or bottom-to-top tilt shots. Finally, end on the sky or a building. Plan the opening and ending of your shot before you start moving.

scenes.context: 比如从人物开始运镜，最后落在樱花和天空；确定大致路线后，往对角线方向运镜就对了。
sentences: 比如我想从人物开始运镜，最后落在樱花和天空结束。
Say I start on a person and end on cherry blossoms and the sky.
cherry blossoms（樱花）
确定好大致路线后，记住要往对角线方向运镜。
Once the rough path is set, remember to move diagonally.
diagonal direction（对角线方向）
预先想好镜头起点和终点，画面会更有目的性。
Knowing your start and end point makes the shot more purposeful.
purposeful（有目的的）
scenes.speak: Say I start on a person and end on cherry blossoms and the sky. Once the rough path is set, remember to move diagonally. Knowing your start and end point makes the shot more purposeful.

scenes.context: 运镜过程中需要改变焦段，可通过切换摇杆模式配合跟焦电机，直接用稳定器快速控制镜头变焦。
sentences: 在运镜过程中需要改变焦段。
During the move you may need to change the focal length.
focal length（焦段）
通过切换摇杆模式，配合跟焦电机。
Switch the joystick mode and pair it with the follow-focus motor.
follow-focus motor（跟焦电机）
直接用稳定器快速控制镜头变焦。
Use the gimbal itself to control zoom quickly.
control the zoom（控制变焦）
scenes.speak: During the move you may need to change the focal length. Switch the joystick mode and pair it with the follow-focus motor. Use the gimbal itself to control zoom quickly.

practice: Two-axis follow adds vertical motion to pan-follow.
Plan the start and end, then move diagonally.
Top-to-bottom or bottom-to-top tilt, ending on the sky.
Switch joystick mode and use the follow-focus motor.
pitfalls: Decide the start and end before you move.
Add vertical motion for richer shots.
Land on the sky or a building.
Switch joystick mode and use the follow-focus motor.
Let the gimbal control the zoom.
shifts: 说运镜只会说 camera move
用 two-axis follow（双轴跟随）、diagonal rule（对角线原则）、tilt shot（摇镜头）
用 follow-focus motor（跟焦电机）、joystick mode（摇杆模式）、focal length（焦段）
用 pan-follow（平移跟随）、vertical movement（上下移动）、plan the route（规划路线）
